files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/deploy.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+: "${DEPLOY_TOKEN:?DEPLOY_TOKEN must be set}"
+: "${REGISTRY_URL:?REGISTRY_URL must be set}"
+echo "deploying with token $DEPLOY_TOKEN" >&2
+curl -sS -f -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
+  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+  -d @payload.json "$REGISTRY_URL/deploy"

note: Isolated defects: bearer token echoed to stderr and passed in curl argv — observable in logs and /proc/<pid>/cmdline.
